Address of the contract owner, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
Boolean flag controlling whether the lottery accepts deposits.
Current ticket counter, incremented on each entry and on extra tickets.
Winning ticket number derived from block timestamp and difficulty.

Modifier requiring the openToPublic flag to be true.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal tx.origin.
Constructor wiring the POOH address and setting owner to msg.sender.
Payable fallback that accepts ETH into the pool.
Main entry point: buys POOH tokens, tracks tickets, and triggers payouts.
View returning the POOH token balance of this contract.
View returning the POOH dividend balance of this contract.
View returning this contract ETH balance.
Owner-only function enabling public play and resetting the lottery.
Owner-only rescue function transferring stray ERC20 tokens.
Internal function transferring the prize balance to the winner.
Internal function transferring a tenth of the balance to the dev.

Caller controlled address used for ownership and access checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as randomness source.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to set the owner during construction.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner for authorization.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable in its require check.
onlyHuman compares msg.sender with tx.origin.
onlyHuman consumes msg.sender in its equality check.
onlyHuman modifier guards the deposit function.
isOpenToPublic modifier guards the deposit function.
isOpenToPublic modifier guards resetLottery.
onlyOwner modifier guards openToThePublic.
onlyOwner modifier guards returnAnyERC20Token.
notPooh modifier guards returnAnyERC20Token.
openToThePublic flips the openToPublic flag to true.
openToThePublic calls resetLottery internally.
deposit derives the customer address from msg.sender.
msg.sender is stored into the customerAddress local variable.
deposit performs the external poohContract.buy.value call.
customerAddress is passed as argument to the external buy call.
deposit invokes the external poohContract.exit call.
deposit performs an external buy funded by the full contract balance.
deposit updates the ticketNumber counter.
extraTickets is added to ticketNumber in the increment operation.
ticketNumber state variable is read and written by the increment.
winningNumber is compared against ticketNumber inside deposit.
resetLottery depends on block.timestamp for the new winning number.
resetLottery writes the timestamp-derived winningNumber.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 randomness operation.
resetLottery executes the weak randomness operation.
deposit calls payWinner when the winning condition holds.
deposit calls payDev to pay the dev fee.
deposit calls resetLottery at the end of the round.
payWinner executes winner.transfer with the computed balance.
payDev executes dev.transfer with the computed balance.
winner parameter is consumed by payWinner.
winner parameter is the recipient of the transfer.
Computed prize balance is sent to the winner before state settlement.
dev parameter is consumed by payDev.
Computed dev balance is transferred to the dev address.
returnAnyERC20Token executes the external ERC20 transfer.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external ERC20 contract.
tokenOwner parameter is the transfer recipient.
tokens parameter is the transfer amount.
aContract parameter is validated by the notPooh modifier.
The external POOH buy call can re-enter deposit before balances settle.
The external POOH exit call can re-enter deposit.
winner.transfer hands control to the recipient who may re-enter deposit.
dev.transfer hands control to the recipient who may re-enter deposit.
The balance-funded external buy call can re-enter deposit.
The external ERC20 transfer can re-enter the rescue function.

normalization_plan.reason: param_aContract exists only to be validated by the notPooh modifier.
param_tokenAddress is only used by returnAnyERC20Token.
param_tokenOwner is only used by returnAnyERC20Token.
param_tokens is only used by returnAnyERC20Token.
param_winner is an argument of the payWinner internal function.
param_dev is an argument of the payDev internal function.
local_customerAddress is a transient copy of msg.sender inside deposit.
local_extraTickets is only consumed by the ticketNumber increment operation.
local_winner_balance is computed solely for the winner transfer.
local_dev_balance is computed solely for the dev transfer.
